description: This Kotlin source file defines a SyncWorker class that performs background synchronization tasks for a Google sample app. It handles syncing repositories, posting analytics events, and managing foreground info for ongoing work.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: A background worker responsible for performing data synchronization tasks in the app, utilizing repositories and reporting status.

methods.name: getForegroundInfo
methods.description: Provides foreground info for ongoing sync operations to Android.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the data synchronization process, synchronizes repositories, logs analytics, and manages retry logic.

methods.name: getChangeListVersions
methods.description: Retrieves the current change list versions from preferences.

methods.name: updateChangeListVersions
methods.description: Updates the change list versions in preferences.

methods.name: startUpSyncWork
methods.description: Creates and schedules an expedited one-time background work request to sync data on app startup.
